notes.title: Early Access Update Notes #1
notes.notes:
Hello Scrapworks Simulator players! Here are the improvements we've made in our latest update:

Improvements

Lighting improvements have been made.



Bug Fixes

The issue causing the money to mistakenly be $10,000 due to a bug has been fixed.



Upcoming Updates

A keybinding customization option will be added.


Updates during the Early Access period will be determined based on player feedback and released in batches. In addition to these updates, various bug fixes will also be implemented.


Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist to be notified when it launches! 🎮✨

💬 You can also support us by sharing your experience in a review for Scrapworks Simulator! 🙌

See you in the game! 🎮

notes.title: Demo Update Notes #2
notes.notes:
Hello Scrapworks Simulator Demo players! Here are the latest updates and improvements we've added to the game:

Improvements
 
Products purchased by customers can now be viewed on the POS device. 
Discounts have been applied to products used in the production line setup. 


Upcoming Updates
 
New maps for scrap collection will be added.
A tutorial for production line setup will be added soon. 
A feature to hire workers for collecting scrap in abandoned areas will be added soon. 


Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to be notified when Scrapworks Simulator is released! 🎮✨

💬Also, you can support us by sharing your experience with a review! 🙌💬

See you in the game! 🎮

notes.title: Demo Update Notes #1
notes.notes:
Hello Scrapworks Simulator Demo players! Here are the new additions and improvements we've made with our latest update:

Improvements
 The positions of the boxes have been adjusted so that when carrying multiple boxes by hand, they no longer obstruct the player's camera view. 
The prices of the Foundry, Warehouse, and Car Workshop buildings have been reduced. 

Bug Fixes 
 A bug that caused the game not to save after bringing scrap found in the tutorial stage to the shop has been fixed. 

If you encountered any of these bugs, we appreciate your patience and understanding.
